title: Multiplication by the adjoined root
statement: Let $ell>0$ and let $m,a$ be length-$ell$ vectors over $mathbb F_2$. Form the monic polynomial $X^{ell}+\sum_{i<\ell}m_iX^i$ and encode a vector by its low-coefficient polynomial in the quotient obtained by adjoining a root of this monic polynomial. If $a'$ is obtained by shifting the coefficients of $a$ up one degree, with constant coefficient zero, and adding $a_{\ell-1}m$, then the encoding of $a'$ equals the adjoined root times the encoding of $a$.
hypotheses_covered: $m$ and $a$ are length-$\ell$ vectors over $\mathbb F_2$
